notes: Printed: '... your second card EACH TURN ...'. On your next turn the draw-step card is your first card that turn and Revitalize's draw is your second, so the Skyfish gains flying (the count restarts each turn and the opponent's draw in between does not count). Re-pinned 2026-10-30 (V2 + B-90 (a), at the cards/integration merge): mana empties as each step and phase ends (CR 500.5), so the mana is added at the step that spends it, standing in for the lands tapped there.
